verified_scope: the examined current master frozen executable policy, collector Python and saved 39 closed trades; not an exhaustive VPS/archive absence claim

frozen_rules.entry_rule: abs(ret1) >= 1.5 * retstd20 and ret1 > 0 and ema20 > ema50
frozen_rules.mechanism_note: Named Supertrend Momentum but frozen evaluator uses high-volatility momentum plus EMA alignment, not an explicitly executed Supertrend ATR trailing line

actual_runner_semantics.signal_observation: rows[i].ts bar open timestamp; engine features calculated using bars through i
actual_runner_semantics.market_loader_behavior: v1._bars calls HTTP _req with 1000-row pagination and returns completed historical OHLC rows, but does not persist complete input bytes/receipt clock in the final trade-row summary

bounded_next_candidate_hypothesis.potential_axis: ema20 <= ema50 on an actually completed post-entry 4h bar, processed only when source receipt as-of proof exists; optional single-axis early exit, original entry/time-stop otherwise unchanged
bounded_next_candidate_hypothesis.risk: A trend break exit may cut largest winners; the 26 observed trades cannot choose or validate the exit threshold without selection bias
